summary: DIAGNOSTIC iPhone-emulation run (Chromium emulation @ 390x844 viewport, iOS UA). Tested 10 public pages + full mobile flows (nav, contact form submission, admin login + Add Wine dialog + image crop overlay). RESULT: Zero JavaScript errors, zero console warnings, zero uncaught page errors, zero React/CRA dev overlays on ANY page or during ANY interaction. No horizontal overflow on any page (document.scrollWidth === document.clientWidth === 390 on all 10 pages). Every interactive flow (mobile menu, contact submit with toast, admin login, add wine dialog, crop overlay + Apply & Upload button) is fully reachable and works. Given the site-owner report of 'a lot of errors on iPhone', I could NOT reproduce any of them under emulated iPhone; the issue is almost certainly (a) a stale cached build on the owner's device, or (b) real-Safari-specific behavior (100vh URL-bar jump, iOS auto-zoom on <16px inputs) that Chromium emulation does not fully replicate. See action_items for iOS-Safari-specific improvements worth applying preemptively.

design_issues.screen: Home hero (iOS Safari specific — NOT reproduced here, but likely source of complaint)
issues: Hero uses h-screen (=100vh). On real iOS Safari, 100vh includes the collapsing URL bar area, so the hero jumps by ~60-90px when the user scrolls and the URL bar hides. Consider min-h-[100svh] (small viewport height) or 100dvh (dynamic viewport height) fallback to remove the jump.

design_issues.screen: Contact form inputs on iOS (NOT reproduced here, but iOS Safari behavior)
issues: InquiryForm text inputs and textarea appear to inherit a font-size below 16px. iOS Safari auto-zooms into any input < 16px, which can look like 'the page is broken / zoomed weird'. Bump form input font-size to >=16px on mobile to prevent auto-zoom.

action_items: OWNER-ACTION: Ask the site owner to (a) force-refresh Safari (Settings → Safari → Clear History and Website Data), (b) confirm the URL they visit is exactly https://vineyard-heritage-1.preview.emergentagent.com, and (c) send a screenshot of the actual 'errors' they see (native iOS dialog vs on-page text vs Safari 'A problem repeatedly occurred'). Without a specific error string this is a phantom bug from our side.

PREEMPTIVE FIX #1 — iOS 100vh jump: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx, change the hero section from `h-screen min-h-[640px]` to `min-h-[100svh] min-h-[640px]` (or `h-[100dvh]`). Tailwind v3.4+ supports svh/dvh. This removes the ~80px URL-bar-collapse content shift that many users perceive as 'broken'.

PREEMPTIVE FIX #2 — iOS input zoom: In InquiryForm and admin login inputs, set font-size to at least 16px on mobile (e.g. add `text-base` = 16px; current inputs may inherit `text-sm` = 14px which triggers Safari auto-zoom-in on focus). Same applies to the admin login form.

PREEMPTIVE FIX #3 (minor): Add data-testid='cancel-crop-wine-bottle' (and equivalent on post-cover uploader) to the CANCEL button in ImageUploader.jsx crop overlay. It is currently only findable by text, which is a small test-brittleness issue.

PREEMPTIVE FIX #4 (minor): Update /app/frontend/public/index.html <meta viewport> to include `viewport-fit=cover` so notched iPhones render edge-to-edge correctly with safe-area insets. Current tag `width=device-width, initial-scale=1` is fine but not notch-aware.

NON-FIX (informational): Add SEO title/description — the <title> is still the default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' on every page, not 'Sineann Winery'. Doesn't cause mobile errors, but shows up in Safari tab UI.

InquiryForm.jsx: verify all mobile input font-size >=16px. Failing to do so causes Safari to zoom into the input on focus, which USERS often report as 'the page is broken / weird / errors'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chromium-based Playwright emulation of iPhone 13 (390x844 viewport, iOS UA) reproduces ZERO of the errors the site owner reported. The most likely real-world causes are (a) iOS Safari 100vh URL-bar jump on the h-screen hero and/or (b) iOS Safari auto-zoom into <16px inputs. Neither shows up as an actual JS/console error, so the owner is probably describing visual/UX glitches as 'errors'. If a re-test after main-agent fixes is needed, use the same script structure: `page.set_viewport_size({width:390,height:844})` + goto each page + assert `document.scrollWidth === document.clientWidth` + click `[data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle']` + submit InquiryForm with testids `inquiry-name`/`inquiry-email`/`inquiry-subject`/`inquiry-message`/`inquiry-submit-button` + login with `admin-email-input`/`admin-password-input`/`admin-login-submit`. Detailed metrics saved to /app/test_reports/mobile/iphone_probe.json.
rca of the issue: NO reproducible errors on emulated iPhone. The site is functionally clean at 390x844. If the owner's report is real, it is one of: (1) stale cached JS on their device (recommend hard clear), (2) iOS-Safari-only 100vh hero jump (fix: use svh/dvh), (3) iOS-Safari auto-zoom on <16px form inputs (fix: enforce 16px+ inputs on mobile), (4) they visited a different/older URL. Cannot RCA further without an exact error string or screenshot from the owner's device.
